name: Bernie Sanders
committees: Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (ranking member)
stance: Wants a permanent ban on artificial superintelligence, a pause on advanced AI development above 10^25 FLOP until a new Department of AI sets rules, and international agreements to the same end.

statements.text: I think we are not all that far away from the development of robotic soldiers,

Right now, politicians — at least sometimes — have to worry about loss of life when they decide to go to war. If you don’t have to worry about loss of life, and what you worry about is loss of robots, what does that mean for issues of war and peace globally? It’s a big issue.
Could a superintelligent AI replace humans in controlling the planet?
So the science fiction fear of AI running the world is not quite so outrageous a concept as people may have thought it was
But AI, which will transform the world economically and socially, is completely unregulated. That’s insane.
Uncontrolled AI poses a severe danger to all of humanity.
That’s why I’m bringing together leading AI scientists from the U.S. and China to discuss the risks posed by AI.
So why hasn’t Congress taken meaningful action to regulate AI?
When will our government wake up?! We need global cooperation — before it’s too late.

If the world's leading scientists say there's even a 10% chance humanity could be destroyed because of uncontrolled AI, shouldn't we do everything possible to prevent it? This isn't about competition with China. It's about coming together to prevent what might be a catastrophe.
After months of resisting all forms of regulation, they have finally acknowledged that out-of-control AI is a danger to humanity and must be regulated.

When Andreesen Horowitz, a Silicon Valley firm with $100 billion in assets, can spend over $115 million to buy politicians who oppose regulating AI & crypto, you know our campaign finance system is broken.
Now, the United States and China are doing exactly what should have happened all along: sitting down to talk.
Artificial intelligence is not. We cannot afford to ignore the warnings.
AI super PACs, funded by Big Tech oligarchs, are spending tens of millions to buy our elections.
We recently learned of the loss of human control and the creation of potentially dangerous viruses from AI.
AI poses a grave threat to jobs and the future of humanity, and urgently addressing the risks should be “the world’s top priority.”
For the sake of humanity CEOs must immediately pause AI development.
The future of humanity cannot be left in the hands of a handful of Big Tech oligarchs.

If the leaders of the major AI companies admit that they are losing control of their extremely dangerous technology, it is time for an immediate PAUSE on advanced AI development and a permanent BAN on superintelligence.
We need an immediate global PAUSE on advanced AI development before it’s too late.
A recent poll shows that the American people overwhelmingly want to ban artificial super intelligence and pause the development of AI until we establish clear safety standards.
The leaders of the major AI companies publicly acknowledge that they do not fully understand the technology and that it is escaping their control.
In other words, advanced AI and superintelligence pose an existential threat to humanity.

When the future of humanity is at stake we need a PAUSE on advanced AI development and a ban on artificial superintelligence — an AI mind smarter than any human and capable of operating independently beyond our control.
I agree with Peggy Noonan, the former Ronald Reagan speechwriter and conservative Wall Street Journal columnist that we need to “hit the brakes hard” and pause AI for humanity’s sake.

If you truly care about the future of humanity, stop pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into super PACs to defeat Members of Congress and candidates who are fighting for serious guardrails on AI.
For the sake of all of humanity, Trump and Xi must negotiate a treaty NOW to pause AI and ban superintelligence before it is too late.
Introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act with Rep. Greg Casar.
Announced he was introducing legislation to permanently ban artificial superintelligence and pause advanced AI until clear safety rules are in place.
But he is right on this: Advanced AI research should not go forward until we have strong guardrails.
You’re asking us to trust the people who stand to make trillions from AI to regulate themselves?
Does anyone in America think it is a good idea to race forward to build machines that replace us?
Mr. Altman: What “bad things” should we accept to advance AI?
So what have Republicans in Congress done to regulate AI over the past two years?
They’re racing to build a technology they can’t control and that threatens humanity.
Now Trump is calling AI's threats a "hoax" and is refusing to rein in Big Tech.
Let me be clear: The creators of any AI model — open-source or not — are not above the law.
If Big Tech Oligarchs are building a product that is threatening the safety of our children and all of humanity, they must be held accountable – no matter how rich and powerful they might be.

We must place an immediate pause on advanced-AI development and ban artificial superintelligence—an artificial mind smarter than any human, capable of operating independently beyond our control—until a new federal body is able to ensure the technology’s safety.
Left unchecked, AI could endanger the entire global financial system — including your bank account.
